reviews.text: I really enjoyed working with Roger at R&E Remodeling. He was professional, knowledgeable, but more than that, he had an understanding of my needs and my budget and was creative in figuring out the best ways I could get what I needed at a price I could afford. He and his crew were professional, clean, conscientious and timely. They arrived on time, worked diligently and thoroughly and left my home cleaner than when they came in. They took care of extra details and went the extra mile. I would definitely call on R&E Remodeling in the future!

Roger was extremely cordial and very willing to assist us in our needs. The project was needed to be completed and corrected ASAP in order to protect our backyard. He and his partner met with us on Sunday and completed the project on Tuesday with no glitches. He was very fair with his price. He is extremely professional and friendly. Will definitely be obtaining his services in the near future. Have also told my neighbors.

reviews.text: Roger and his crew did quality work, and really care about the outcome of the project. We had a complete basement remodel with full bathroom done and we are extremely happy with how it turned out. I wish we would have found Roger years ago to do our other bathroom remodels. Roger is very professional and maintains excellent communication- which was key to my family being happy with his work. Thanks again Roger!

facts.about_text: R&E Remodeling LLC provides homeowners with a quality experience during their home project. Here at R&E Remodeling LLC, we take our job as a true labor of love. We have extensive experience with Bathroom Remodeling and we know that it requires particular skills and attention to detail that we have acquired during our many years as contractors.
